# Product

> Fill this in when starting a new project from this template. Keep it
> current — the agent reads this to understand *what* is being built and
> *why*, so requirements and design stay aligned with actual product
> intent instead of being invented per-feature.

## Vision

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this product do, for whom? -->

## Problem

<!-- What problem does this solve? What happens today without it? -->

## Target users

<!-- Who uses this, and in what role/context? -->

## Goals

<!-- What this product must achieve to be considered successful. -->

## Non-goals

<!-- Explicitly out of scope, so features don't scope-creep into these. -->

## Success metrics

<!-- How "working" will be measured, if known. -->

## Glossary

The project's ubiquitous language lives in `docs/domain/glossary.md` —
add and define domain terms there, not here.
